brief.headline: Move from 100% advance to 30-day credit (frees ₹8.73 L of our cash) and close the ₹12.95 L/year price gap to our best supplier

priceAsk.summary: Match the ₹66.48/KG we pay Sayaji Industries Limited for Dextrose
priceAsk.basis: We already buy the same material at ₹66.48/KG from Sayaji — that's 6.5% less than the ₹70.80/KG we pay Sukhjit. The open market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP runs ₹60–81/kg (typically ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48/KG sits right in the middle of fair market range and is the best price we currently pay anyone.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Switch from 100% advance to normal 30-day credit after delivery
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹8.73 L of our cash that's locked in advance payments right now

brief.financialLeverage: Sukhjit is big — ₹1555.82 Cr in sales — but only keeps 2.9% as profit, so there's not much cushion for deep price cuts. They're growing fast (29.7% a year), which means they want more orders. We're tiny to them: our ₹1.06 Cr spend is just 0.07% of their revenue, so on our own we don't have much pull. The play is to offer a multi-year volume commitment in exchange for matching our best price and moving to normal payment terms — they get guaranteed growth volume, we get the savings and our cash back.

evidence.point: We pay ₹70.80/KG; our best price anywhere is ₹66.48/KG
Closing that 6.5% gap saves us ₹12.95 L every year
We pay them 100% in advance right now
Shifting to 30-day credit frees up ₹8.73 L of our cash
Their sales are growing 29.7% per year — they want volume
We're 0.07% of their ₹1555.82 Cr revenue — very small customer

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health score B (62/100) — established dextrose supplier and a drop-in alternate to Sayaji

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist, ₹821.13 Cr revenue, health score C (57/100) — makes starch and dextrose, growing capacity

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller, ₹365.39 Cr revenue — makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS at IV-fluid grade (exact form match); confirm IP monograph CoA before switching

risks: We're only 0.07% of their business (₹1.06 Cr vs ₹1555.82 Cr), so they can easily walk away if we push too hard without offering something in return
They keep just 2.9% profit, so a heavy-handed price squeeze could make this supplier unprofitable for them and put our supply at risk
Paying 100% advance means we have zero leverage once the order is placed — fix payment terms first, then push price in the next cycle
Their health score is D (44/100), so watch for any signs of supply disruption and line up Gulshan or Sanstar as a qualified second source now
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to continue growing with you, but we need two changes to make that work: match the ₹66.48/KG we're paying our best supplier for the same Dextrose, and move us from 100% advance to standard 30-day credit like our other vendors.
